status: authored 2026-09-30; file-valid only. Nothing here has been seen in a running game.
supersedes_why: the COBBLEVERSE donor shell (cobbleverse:sabrina, 27x17x24 at 6183,96,3306..6209,112,3329, one oval room, no second storey, its own rctmod:trainer_spawner) stands on this lot and is taken down by this function's own two clearing parts. Gyms 6 and 8 have NO record in data/gym_interiors.json with `superseded_by`, so tools/gym_demolish.py does not act on them and there is no dig under them to fill in - nothing was ever carved here. The clearing fills cover the donor's box on every axis: air from y98 to y128 and stone from y92 to y97, over x6182-6210 z3306-3332.
name: The Hall of Lenses
reading: Sabrina's town is the region's place of study: it records what the Rift does to memory and perception, and its signature dressing is memory stones on plinths (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym6_town: calcite, smooth quartz, polished diorite, birch; purpur and end rods as accents). The gym stands at the head of the white axis on the highest ground, looking straight back down it, so its south gable and its door are what the whole town sees. Inside it is one tall hall with a reading gallery running right round it and a closed chamber over the gallery's north third, and the work of the place - shelving, reading stalls, lecterns, a lens let into the floor - is what a player climbs. THE PER-PLAYER DESIGN IS RETIRED. The owner, 2026-09-30: 'Sabrina's was blocked on a per-player design - redesign it shared like the other six.' Nothing here is instanced, nothing is lit for one player and nothing is held in one player's state. What replaces it is THE EYE: one purpur panel with a pearlescent-froglight pupil, set in the fabric of the building three times, once over each way on. It is a thing in the world that tells you which way, the same for everyone, in the family of Brock's lit slot and Misty's three mouths.

site.lot_source: data/placements.json settlements.gym6_town.plan.anchors gym6_gym (rect [6180,3302,6212,3334], level 97, facing south). The plan's prep_note: 'The gym lot at the top needs a small cut into the rise.' tools/place_town.py cuts and fills a levelled lot to its level, so the pad is y97.

ground.why: the pad is the ground. The raw heightmap over the lot rect runs y95 to y97 (tools/ground.py, rounded, measured for this record: min 95, max 97) and the prep levels it to 97, which is the top of that range - a small cut and a two-course fill, exactly what the prep_note says. Neither number was read from a world save (the ground rule, tests/test_ground_rule.py).

The eaves overhang one course all round (x6182-6210, z3306-3332) and still stand two clear of the lot edge on every side, so the gym lot's own perimeter - where a player arrives from the town - is untouched pad at y97 the whole way round.

bounds_why: the hall (6183..6209 x 3307..3331), its one-course eaves (x6182 and x6210, z3306 and z3332), the ridge at y124, and downward to y92 for the six courses of rock this function re-makes under the pad. leader.name: Sabrina
leader.why: kanto_sabrina is the upstream Radical Cobblemon Trainers id and it is load-bearing: a persistent leader trainer anywhere awards the badge (verified on staging 2026-09-24, docs/STATE.md). EXP-013 E2 (VERIFIED, on staging): a bare rctmod:trainer_spawner set by command with TrainerIds on a redstone block spawned the leader and he battled. The donor shell's own spawner goes with the shell in this function's clearing fill, so this is the only kanto_sabrina in the town and the badge cannot be won without reaching the lens chamber.

rooms.why: the reading hall: the whole ground floor, twenty-five by twenty-three, floor course y97 and walked at y98, six courses of headroom under the gallery's soffit. Four stacks of record shelving rise out of it and three of them stop short.

the reading gallery: a ring four wide on all four sides at floor course y104, walked at y105, round a well seventeen by fifteen that is open from the hall floor to the roof. No rail stands on it anywhere (GYM_BUILDINGS_REVIEW D7). Its ceiling is the chamber's floor over the north third and the open roof elsewhere.

the ladder turret, three by three of quartz walls standing on the gallery's north strip, entered by one door in its west wall which is reached only through the arcade's true arch. The ladder is the only thing in it.

the lens chamber over the gallery's north third: floor course y111, walked at y112, six courses to its ceiling at y118, closed on six sides with exactly two openings - the ladder's hole and the drop shaft. Sabrina sits at the centre of the lens let into its floor.

route.why: four stacks of record shelving rise out of the hall floor. The finished one runs east along the well's south edge at z3325-3326 with tops y98,99,100,101,102,103,103, so a player steps up one course at a time to feet y104 at x6203-6204 and then one more course east onto the gallery's east arm (floor course y104, walked at y105) or south onto its south strip. The waypoints are standing cells: (6196,98,3320) is hall floor with the floor course at y97 under it, and (6205,105,3325) is the east arm with its floor course at y104 under it.
route.not_skippable: the gallery's floor occupies y104 the whole way round, so its walking level is y105 and the hall floor is y98: seven courses. The three decoy stacks top at y102, which puts a player's feet at y103 - a two-block rise to the gallery, which vanilla does not allow and which no jump covers (the audit's own reach table gives three blocks for a jump up one and nothing at all for a jump up two). Every decoy stands three or more cells clear of the gallery's edge. The quartz posts under the gallery stop at y102 and are capped by its soffit at y103, so none of them can be stood on. Nothing else in the hall rises above y103.

route.why: the gallery is a closed ring, so from the east arm a player walks it round - south strip, west arm, north strip - to the arcade. The arcade is a calcite screen two courses thick across the north strip at x6191-6192, from the strip's floor to the chamber's floor at y111, with three recesses at y105-106. Two are one course deep and blind; the third, at z3309, goes through to the pocket at x6193. The eye is set in the screen directly over it. Both waypoints are standing cells on the gallery's floor course y104.
route.not_skippable: the screen closes the north strip over its full height, from the floor a player walks on to the chamber's floor above it, and the turret's door is behind it. The blind recesses are backed by the screen's second course at x6192, which is never cut. There is no other opening: the turret's west, east and south walls are solid quartz from y105 to y110 and its north side is the building's own north wall.

route.why: inside the turret a ladder[facing=west] runs from y105 to y111 on the east wall at (6197,y,3309), carried by the solid quartz at x6198 for y105-110 and by the chamber's own floor course at y111. A player climbs to feet y111 and steps up and across onto the chamber floor at feet y112. The fill that writes it is the LAST block part in the record, after the chamber's floor, and it re-cuts the floor's cell as LADDER rather than air: GYM_BUILDINGS_REVIEW D2, where exactly this cut was made to air and Brock's gym could not be finished. Both waypoints are standing cells - (6196,105,3309) on the turret floor (gallery floor course y104 under it) and (6196,112,3309) on the chamber floor (course y111 under it).
route.not_skippable: the chamber's floor at y111 is unbroken over the whole of x6184-6208 z3308-3318 but for this ladder cell and the drop shaft at (6206,111,3314). The chamber's walking level is y112 and the gallery's is y105 - seven courses - so the shaft cannot be climbed and nothing under the chamber can be jumped to it.

route.why: the chamber is one room and Sabrina stands at the centre of the quartz lens let into its floor, on a redstone block at (6196,111,3312) with two air cells over her. Her chest is four cells east at (6200,112,3312). The eye is set in the north wall behind her. (6195,112,3312) is the standing cell beside the spawner, on the chamber's floor course.

the way back down, and the reason this chamber is not a trap (GYM_BUILDINGS_REVIEW D8: Blaine's vault had no exit at all and 192 positions could not regain the lot). One cell is cut in the chamber's floor over the gallery's east arm. Stepping into it is a seven-block fall from y112 onto the arm's floor course at y104, landing with the feet at y105 for four damage - inside data/gym_interiors.json rules.max_fall of 12 and inside the ten damage a route may cost, so it needs no hay and none is used. The ladder is the other way out. Both waypoints are standing cells: (6205,112,3314) on the chamber floor beside the hole, (6206,105,3314) on the east arm.

trainers_why: none authored, exactly as gyms 1, 3, 4, 5 and 7. A gym trainer has to be unavoidable, and unavoidability is a claim about where a player can physically stand and how far a trainer can see - the independent movement model settles that, and it is not this unit's to write (CLAUDE.md principle 16). The `trainers` array is supported by the generator and lands in derived/gym_buildings/trainer_seats.json for trainer-balance-designer. The three places that would hold one are the hall floor by the door, the gallery's south strip, and the chamber's threshold at the head of the ladder.

no_build.why: the whole hall. Authored, not wired: the scene runtime's adventure-mode box (tools/scenes_pack.py no_build) needs a scene record in data/scenes.json and that is not written in this unit. Until it is, a player with blocks can pillar out of the well onto the gallery and skip both the stacks and the arcade.

spawn_suppression.note: data/spawn_suppression.json gym_sabrina, UNCHANGED, and this building lies wholly inside it. That is by construction and it was the binding constraint on the footprint: the box's north edge is z3304 while the gym lot runs north to z3302, so the lot's two northernmost rows are NOT covered and nothing is built on them. Every written cell of this record lies in x6182-6210 (inside 6176-6215) and z3306-3332 (inside 3304-3335). The box is already whole 8-blocks - 6176/8=772, 3304/8=413, 6216/8=777, 3336/8=417 - so tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py does not fail closed on it and no change to data/spawn_suppression.json is needed for this gym. Growing it would have had to be an outward snap to the 8-block grid, which cost a cycle on 2026-09-30 at four other gyms; building inside it costs nothing.

blocks_why: the town's own palette (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym6_town: calcite, smooth quartz, polished diorite, birch; purpur and end rods as accents) plus the lamp the town plan already names for this settlement (minecraft:pearlescent_froglight, 'a pale violet light for the psychic town ... not a spawn condition'). There is NO water and NO lava in this gym, so no source can leak and nothing can drown; no leaves, so nothing decays; no soul sand, so there is no bubble column to prove; and no lanterns or chains anywhere - every light in the building is a froglight let flush into a floor or a wall, which is a full block and cannot pop. Thirty-one lanterns stood in mid air across the five interiors this work replaces, and four of Misty's still do.
